text: The Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4) is a financial instrument designed to provide the Philippines with immediate access to funds following a state of calamity or public health emergency. It is part of a broader disaster risk financing strategy that includes catastrophe bonds and insurance arrangements, aimed at providing a multi-tiered response to natural disasters and public health emergencies.
